visual_goal: Show the level-1 capability map: the vehicle data foundation feeds every domain and learns from the dealer platform and registration, while platform foundations underpin products.
prompt: A layered map illustration. Top center, a wide blue block with a database-and-car icon labeled 'Vehicle Data Foundation'. Middle row, four teal blocks side by side from left to right: 'Dealer Platform', 'Registration and Trade', 'Data Products', 'Consumer'. Four blue downward arrows, one from the top block into the top edge of each middle block; one small blue caption 'facts and values' beside the downward arrows. Two orange upward arrows: one rising from the top edge of 'Dealer Platform' (the leftmost block) up into the top block, with the orange text 'stock and sales' next to it; and one rising from the top edge of 'Registration and Trade' (the second block) up into the top block, with the orange text 'ownership changes' next to it. Each of the two left middle blocks therefore has one blue arrow in and one orange arrow out. Bottom, a wide green foundation slab under the middle row labeled 'Platform Foundations', with two green upward arrows into 'Dealer Platform' and 'Data Products', with the green text 'who, may they, what was used'. These ten labels are the only words in the image.
alt: Vehicle Data Foundation feeds facts and values to Dealer Platform, Registration and Trade, Data Products and Consumer; dealer stock and sales and ownership changes flow back; Platform Foundations underpin the products.

visual_goal: Show two separate questions: the investment class (differentiating, parity, commodity) and the sharing test (same answer about the same car or customer), answered independently.
prompt: A two-stage sorting illustration, left to right. Left stage: a funnel-shaped sorter with a question-mark icon labeled 'Investment class', with three output trays stacked vertically: blue 'Differentiating', teal 'Parity', grey 'Commodity'. All three trays send one arrow each to the right into a single second sorter with a car-and-person icon labeled 'Same answer?'. From the second sorter, two output trays: an upper green tray labeled 'Shared' with an arrow labeled 'yes', and a lower orange tray labeled 'Half-owned' with an arrow labeled 'no'. These nine labels are the only words in the image.
alt: First, a sorter assigns each capability to differentiating, parity or commodity; then every class passes a second test, same answer about the same car or customer, which sorts it into shared or half-owned.
